name: Herschel
about: Herschel (2009-026A, ESA), launched 2009 May 14. Its phases from GCAT: SEL2, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
about the Sun-Earth L2 point, about 1.5 million km beyond the Earth: shown as an orbit like the Earth's, 1% outside, with the halo or Lissajous loop left out
GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; turned to start where it left SEL2
